metas.name: The Shield
metas.description: Because you watched Sons of Anarchy: Kurt Sutter cut his teeth writing Vic Mackey's corrupt LA Strike Team, handheld and relentless for seven seasons.

metas.name: Kin
metas.description: Because you watched Love/Hate: Aidan Gillen (Love/Hate's John Boy) heads a Dublin crime family at war with Ciarán Hinds' heroin kingpin.

metas.name: The Responder
metas.description: Because you watched Blue Lights: Martin Freeman as a burnt-out Liverpool response cop on endless night shifts; written by an ex-copper.

metas.name: Utopia
metas.description: Because you watched Mr. Robot: Dennis Kelly's lurid, paranoid Channel 4 conspiracy thriller: candy-coloured and shockingly violent.

metas.name: Halt and Catch Fire
metas.description: Because you watched Mad Men: AMC's other great period drama: the 80s PC boom through four brilliant, damaged people.

metas.name: Boys from the Blackstuff
metas.description: Because you watched Kes: Alan Bleasdale's 1982 Liverpool dole-queue masterpiece; Yosser Hughes' 'Gizza job' is British TV's rawest cry.

metas.name: Nathan Barley
metas.description: Because you watched Cunk on Life: Charlie Brooker co-wrote it with Chris Morris: a savage 2005 takedown of Shoreditch media idiots.

metas.name: Garth Marenghi's Darkplace
metas.description: Because you watched The Young Ones: the same anarchic spirit: a deliberately terrible 80s horror show with Holness, Ayoade and Matt Berry.

metas.name: Vinland Saga
metas.description: Because you watched Berserk: a Viking revenge epic with Berserk's brutality that becomes a rare meditation on escaping violence.

metas.name: Monster
metas.description: Because you watched Hunter x Hunter: Madhouse's 74-episode thriller: a surgeon hunts the boy he once saved across post-Wall Germany.
